card.name: Sentence-ending periods and degree signs
card.fires_on: Full stops that end a sentence in web prose, and the degree-F sign after a temperature number in storage instructions. Also a dash between dates in a birth-death range.

modes.label: Sentence-ending period
modes.description: A period closing a sentence, just before the next sentence begins.

modes.description: A dash between birth and death dates in a biography.
